title: PDA occluders
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: PDA occluder

states.label: 1. Anatomy only
states.note: An enlarged representative section; dimensions and tissue shapes are not measured on a specific patient or population.

states.label: 2. Compact illustration
states.note: A simplified narrow device pose, not a delivery instruction or a simulated deployment.

states.label: 3. Expanded illustration
states.note: A representative expanded pose. Contact, sealing, tissue deformation and flow are not calculated.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the region
views.lesson: The enlarged marker orients the separate representative diagrams.

views.label: Great vessels and duct
views.title: Locate the duct between the aorta and the pulmonary artery
views.lesson: The aorta and the pulmonary artery come from a real heart model with walls added, seen from the left. The duct is not in the model; a short representative duct joins the top of the pulmonary artery, near its left branch, to the underside of the aorta where the arch turns down. Its position and size are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Tissue section
views.title: See both sides of the tissue
views.lesson: Follow the connection between two vascular lumens, then compare the compact and expanded generic plug.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: See the three-dimensional relationship
views.lesson: A representative oblique view separates the near and far components.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look toward the channel
views.lesson: Use this complementary view to distinguish tissue, the device and the opening.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

aorta.label: DESCENDING AORTA
aorta.body: The rose-colored parent lumen is a representative descending-aortic cutaway.

pulmonary.label: PULMONARY ARTERY
pulmonary.body: The green parent lumen is a representative pulmonary-arterial cutaway.

duct.label: DUCTAL CONNECTION
duct.body: A short vascular channel joins the two parent lumens. This is outside the cardiac septa; the near walls are removed to show the inside.

plug.label: EXPANDED PLUG
plug.body: The generic plug occupies the ductal channel; an aortic-side retention rim is shown. No residual flow or sealing is calculated.

compact.label: COMPACT POSE
compact.body: The narrow illustration contrasts with the expanded pose; a sheath and delivery sequence are omitted.

region_aorta.label: AORTA
region_aorta.body: The aortic arch and the start of the descending aorta. The duct joins the underside of the arch where it turns down.

region_pa_branch.label: LEFT PULMONARY ARTERY
region_pa_branch.body: The left branch of the pulmonary artery runs backward from the top of the trunk. The duct leaves the pulmonary artery near the start of this branch.

region_pa_trunk.label: PULMONARY TRUNK
region_pa_trunk.body: The main pulmonary artery rises in front of the aorta before it divides.

region_duct.label: ARTERIAL DUCT
region_duct.body: A short vessel outside the heart joining the two great arteries, opened here to show its inside. Its course and size are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_device.label: GENERIC DUCTAL PLUG
region_device.body: The generic plug fills the opened duct, with a retention rim at the aortic end. Its shape and size are representative and do not represent a specific product. Sealing and flow are not calculated.
